set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
sample_path <- args[[2]]
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
counts_df <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df <- read.csv(sample_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df$CountColumn <- gsub('-', '_', sample_df$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep_meta <- sample_df[sample_df$Group %in% c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'), ]
if (nrow(keep_meta) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')
if (!all(keep_meta$CountColumn %in% colnames(counts_df))) {
  stop(paste('Missing count columns:', paste(setdiff(keep_meta$CountColumn, colnames(counts_df)), collapse=',')))
}
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, keep_meta$CountColumn, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
colnames(count_mat) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
rownames(keep_meta) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
keep_meta$Group <- factor(keep_meta$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=keep_meta, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('gene_id', setdiff(names(res_df), 'gene_id'))]
write.table(res_df, file='de_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
fg <- !is.na(res_df$padj) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5
up <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange > 0.5]
down <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5]
universe <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')
summary_df <- data.frame(
  contrast='CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO',
  reference='DMSO',
  target='CBD_IC50',
  alpha=0.05,
  log2fc_abs_threshold=0.5,
  tested_genes=length(universe),
  significant_up=length(up),
  significant_down=length(down),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
write.table(summary_df, file='de_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
sample_path <- args[[2]]
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
counts_df <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df <- read.csv(sample_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df$CountColumn <- gsub('-', '_', sample_df$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep_meta <- sample_df[sample_df$Group %in% c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'), ]
if (nrow(keep_meta) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')
if (!all(keep_meta$CountColumn %in% colnames(counts_df))) {
  stop(paste('Missing count columns:', paste(setdiff(keep_meta$CountColumn, colnames(counts_df)), collapse=',')))
}
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, keep_meta$CountColumn, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
colnames(count_mat) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
rownames(keep_meta) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
keep_meta$Group <- factor(keep_meta$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=keep_meta, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('gene_id', setdiff(names(res_df), 'gene_id'))]
write.table(res_df, file='de_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
fg <- !is.na(res_df$padj) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5
up <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange > 0.5]
down <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5]
universe <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')

  contrast='CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO',
  reference='DMSO',
  target='CBD_IC50',
  alpha=0.05,
  log2fc_abs_threshold=0.5,
  tested_genes=length(universe),
  significant_up=length(up),
  significant_down=length(down),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
write.table(summary_df, file='de_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

  stop("sample_layout.csv must contain SampleID and Group columns")
}
layout$SampleID_norm <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed = TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
meta <- layout[keep, , drop = FALSE]
missing_samples <- setdiff(meta$SampleID_norm, colnames(counts))
if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing count columns:", paste(missing_samples, collapse = ",")))
}
meta <- meta[match(meta$SampleID_norm, colnames(counts)), , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$SampleID_norm), , drop = FALSE]
counts_sub <- counts[, meta$SampleID_norm, drop = FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_sub)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"
count_matrix <- round(count_matrix)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"
coldata <- data.frame(Group = factor(meta$Group, levels = c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")), row.names = meta$SampleID_norm)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix, colData = coldata, design = ~ Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"), alpha = 0.05)
df <- data.frame(gene_id = rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names = FALSE)

down <- de$gene_id[de$log2FoldChange < 0]
universe <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, con = "up_genes.txt")
writeLines(down, con = "down_genes.txt")
writeLines(universe, con = "universe_genes.tsv")

write.table(summary, file = "de_summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, header=TRUE, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
layout$count_col <- gsub('-', '_', layout$SampleID)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c('DMSO', 'CBD_IC50')
layout2 <- layout[keep, , drop=FALSE]
if (nrow(layout2) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')
if (!all(layout2$count_col %in% colnames(counts))) stop('Some selected samples are absent from count matrix')
counts2 <- as.matrix(counts[, layout2$count_col, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(counts2) <- 'integer'
colnames(counts2) <- layout2$SampleID
rownames(layout2) <- layout2$SampleID
layout2$Group <- factor(layout2$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts2, colData=layout2[, c('Group'), drop=FALSE], design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
out <- as.data.frame(res)
out$gene_id <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c('gene_id','baseMean','log2FoldChange','lfcSE','stat','pvalue','padj')]
write.table(out, file='deseq2_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
sig <- out[!is.na(out$padj) & out$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, , drop=FALSE]
up <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange > 0, 'gene_id']
down <- sig[sig$log2FoldChange < 0, 'gene_id']
universe <- out[!is.na(out$padj), 'gene_id']
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')
metrics <- data.frame(metric=c('contrast','tested_genes_with_non_na_padj','significant_up','significant_down'), value=c('CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO', length(universe), length(up), length(down)))
write.table(metrics, file='de_metrics.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq2.R '$(inputs.counts.path)' '$(inputs.layout.path)'

storage.mode(counts2) <- 'integer'

rownames(layout2) <- layout2$SampleID
layout2$Group <- factor(layout2$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts2, colData=layout2[, c('Group'), drop=FALSE], design=~Group)

out <- as.data.frame(res)

import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from gprofiler import GProfiler

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
layout['sample'] = layout['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
layout = layout.set_index('sample')
counts = counts.loc[:, layout.index]
counts = counts.loc[counts.sum(axis=1) > 0]
metadata = layout[['Group']].copy()
metadata['Group'] = metadata['Group'].astype('category')

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts.T.astype(int), metadata=metadata, design='~Group', quiet=True, n_cpus=4)
dds.deseq2()
stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, quiet=True, n_cpus=4)
stat.summary()
res = stat.results_df.copy()
# g:Profiler strips versioned IDs, but these are already unversioned Ensembl IDs.
universe = res[res['padj'].notna()].index.tolist()
sig = res[(res['padj'] < 0.05) & (res['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 0.5)]
up = sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] > 0].index.tolist()
down = sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] < 0].index.tolist()
print('DE_COUNTS universe', len(universe), 'sig', len(sig), 'up', len(up), 'down', len(down))

gp = GProfiler(return_dataframe=True)
for label, genes in [('up', up), ('down', down)]:
    enr = gp.profile(organism='hsapiens', query=genes, sources=['GO:BP'], background=universe, user_threshold=0.05, significance_threshold_method='fdr')
    if enr is None or len(enr)==0:
        print(label, 'NO_TERMS')
        continue
    # keep significant GO:BP (gprofiler already thresholded by user_threshold but retain explicit column)
    e = enr[enr['significant']].copy()

    if len(e):

        print(e[['native','name','p_value','intersection_size','term_size','query_size']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
    if len(metab):
        print('top metabolic')
        print(metab[['native','name','p_value','intersection_size','term_size','query_size']].head(30).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from gprofiler import GProfiler

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
meta = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['sample'] = meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
meta = meta.set_index('sample')
# Use all samples in the one-factor design; contrast CBD against vehicle DMSO.
counts_t = counts.T
counts_t.index = counts_t.index.astype(str)
counts_t = counts_t.loc[meta.index]
meta = meta.loc[counts_t.index, ['Group']].copy()
print('counts_t', counts_t.shape)
print(meta['Group'].value_counts().to_string())

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_t, metadata=meta, design='~ Group', ref_level=['Group','DMSO'], n_cpus=4, quiet=False)
dds.deseq2()
stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, n_cpus=4, quiet=False)
stat.summary()
res = stat.results_df.copy()
print(res.head())
print(res.columns)
# Filter valid tested genes
res_valid = res.dropna(subset=['padj','log2FoldChange'])
sig = res_valid[(res_valid['padj'] < 0.05) & (res_valid['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 0.5)]
up = sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] > 0].index.astype(str).tolist()
down = sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] < 0].index.astype(str).tolist()
universe = res_valid.index.astype(str).tolist()
print('valid_universe', len(universe), 'sig', len(sig), 'up', len(up), 'down', len(down))
print('top up', sig.sort_values('log2FoldChange', ascending=False).head(5)[['log2FoldChange','padj']].to_string())
print('top down', sig.sort_values('log2FoldChange').head(5)[['log2FoldChange','padj']].to_string())

gp = GProfiler(return_dataframe=True)
for name, genes in [('up', up), ('down', down)]:
    if not genes:
        print(name, 'no genes')
        continue
    enr = gp.profile(organism='hsapiens', query=genes, sources=['GO:BP'], user_threshold=0.05, background=universe, no_evidences=False)
    if enr is None or len(enr)==0:
        print(name, 'no enrichment')
        continue
    print('\\nENR', name, 'terms', len(enr))
    cols=['native','name','p_value','term_size','query_size','intersection_size']
    print(enr[cols].head(25).to_string(index=False))
    met = enr[enr['name'].str.contains('metabolic|metabolism|catabolic|biosynthetic|glycol|oxidative|respir|mitochond|lipid|fatty|amino acid|carbohydrate|nucleotide|protein', case=False, regex=True, na=False)]
    print('METLIKE', name, len(met))
    print(met[cols].head(30).to_string(index=False))
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from gprofiler import GProfiler
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
meta=pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['sample']=meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
meta=meta.set_index('sample')
meta=meta.loc[meta['Group'].isin(['DMSO','CBD_IC50']), ['Group']]
cts=counts.T.loc[meta.index]
dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=cts, metadata=meta, design='~ Group', n_cpus=4, quiet=True)
dds.deseq2()
st=DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, n_cpus=4, quiet=True)
st.summary()
res=st.results_df.dropna(subset=['padj','log2FoldChange'])
sig=res[(res.padj<0.05)&(res.log2FoldChange.abs()>0.5)]
sets={'up':sig[sig.log2FoldChange>0].index.astype(str).tolist(), 'down':sig[sig.log2FoldChange<0].index.astype(str).tolist()}
universe=res.index.astype(str).tolist()
print('DE', len(res), len(sig), {k:len(v) for k,v in sets.items()})
gp=GProfiler(return_dataframe=True)
pattern='metabolic|metabolism|catabolic|biosynthetic|glycol|oxidative|respir|mitochond|lipid|fatty|amino acid|carbohydrate|nucleotide|protein'
for direction, genes in sets.items():
    enr=gp.profile(organism='hsapiens', query=genes, sources=['GO:BP'], user_threshold=1.0, background=universe)
    print('\\nDIR',direction,'rows',0 if enr is None else len(enr))
    if enr is None or len(enr)==0: continue
    # hypergeometric raw p from custom universe dimensions, BH across returned hit terms
    e=enr.copy()
    N=int(e['effective_domain_size'].iloc[0])
    e['raw_p_hypergeom']=hypergeom.sf(e['intersection_size'].astype(int)-1, N, e['term_size'].astype(int), e['query_size'].astype(int))
    e['bh']=multipletests(e['raw_p_hypergeom'].to_numpy(), method='fdr_bh')[1]
    sig_e=e[e['bh']<0.05].sort_values('bh')
    met=sig_e[sig_e['name'].str.contains(pattern, case=False, regex=True, na=False)]
    print('N',N,'query_size',e['query_size'].iloc[0],'sig_terms_BH',len(sig_e),'metlike_BH',len(met))
    print(sig_e[['native','name','raw_p_hypergeom','bh','term_size','query_size','intersection_size']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
    print('METLIKE')
    print(met[['native','name','raw_p_hypergeom','bh','term_size','query_size','intersection_size']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
PY"

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without

class: GalaxyUserTool

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

background=[g for g,lfc,padj in rows if padj is not None]

down=[g for g,lfc,padj in rows if padj is not None and padj < 0.05 and lfc is not None and lfc < -0.5]
for name, vals in [('background',background),('upregulated',up),('downregulated',down)]:

print('background',len(background))

ora <- function(fg, universe) {
  universe <- intersect(unique(universe),ann"'$ENSEMBL)
  fg <- intersect(unique(fg),universe)
  a <- ann[ann$ENSEMBL %in% universe,,drop=FALSE]
  gs <- split(a$ENSEMBL,a$GOALL)
  gs <- lapply(gs,unique)
  gs <- gs[lengths(gs)>=10 & lengths(gs)<=500]
  N <- length(universe); n <- length(fg)
  k <- vapply(gs,function(z) sum(fg %in% z),integer(1))
  K <- lengths(gs)
  tested <- k>0
  out <- data.frame(GOID=names(gs)[tested],k=k[tested],K=K[tested],n=n,N=N,
                    pvalue=phyper(k[tested]-1,K[tested],N-K[tested],n,lower.tail=FALSE),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  out$padj <- p.adjust(out$pvalue,'"'BH')
  out"'$TERM <- unname(name_map[out$GOID])
  out$metabolic <- out$GOID %in% metabolic_ids
  out <- out[order(out$padj,out$pvalue,-out$k,out$GOID),]
  out
}
report_ora <- function(obj,label,bgfield=c('"'pvalue','padj')) {

    uni <- obj"'$res$ENSEMBL[!is.na(obj$res[[bg]])]

      sig <- z["'!is.na(z$padj)&z$padj<.05,,drop=FALSE]

      cat('"'\\nORA',label,'background',bg,'direction',direction,'\\n')
      cat('foreground_mapped',if(nrow(z)) z"'$n[1] else 0,'"'universe_mapped',if(nrow(z))z"'$N[1] else 0,

      cat('TOP_ALL\\n'); print(head(sig[,c('GOID','TERM','k','K','padj','metabolic')],15),row.names=FALSE)
      cat('TOP_METABOLIC\\n'); print(head(mets[,c('GOID','TERM','k','K','padj')],25),row.names=FALSE)
    }
  }
}

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0)
org=sqlite3.connect('.go_tmp/org.sqlite'); go=sqlite3.connect('.go_tmp/go.sqlite')
ensmap=pd.read_sql_query('select distinct e.ensembl_id, g.gene_id from ensembl e join genes g on e._id=g._id',org)
gomap=pd.read_sql_query('select distinct g.gene_id, b.go_id from go_bp_all b join genes g on b._id=g._id',org)
terms=pd.read_sql_query(\"select go_id,term from go_term where ontology='BP'\",go)
term_name=dict(zip(terms.go_id,terms.term))
rootid=go.execute(\"select _id from go_term where go_id='GO:0008152'\").fetchone()[0]
metabolic={r[0] for r in go.execute('select t.go_id from go_bp_offspring x join go_term t on x._offspring_id=t._id where x._id=?',(rootid,))}
metabolic.add('GO:0008152')
# Universe all nonzero count rows mapped to Entrez, same mapping policy as foreground
modeled=set(counts.index[counts.sum(axis=1)>0])
map_by_ens=ensmap.groupby('ensembl_id').gene_id.apply(set).to_dict()
def mapgenes(gs): return set().union(*(map_by_ens.get(x,set()) for x in gs)) if gs else set()
univ=mapgenes(modeled)
gomap=gomap[gomap.gene_id.isin(univ)]
sets=gomap.groupby('go_id').gene_id.apply(set).to_dict()
sets={goid:s for goid,s in sets.items() if 10<=len(s)<=500}
print('modeled ensembl',len(modeled),'mapped universe Entrez',len(univ),'GO BP sets tested',len(sets),'metabolic ontology terms total',len(metabolic))
def ora(fg):
 fg=fg & univ; N=len(univ); n=len(fg); rows=[]
 for goid,s in sets.items():
  k=len(fg&s)
  if k:
   rows.append((goid,term_name.get(goid,''),k,len(s),hypergeom.sf(k-1,N,len(s),n)))
 z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['go_id','term','hits','setsize','p'])
 z['padj']=multipletests(z.p,method='fdr_bh')[1]
 z['fold_enrich']=(z.hits/n)/(z.setsize/N)
 z['metabolic']=z.go_id.isin(metabolic)
 return z.sort_values(['padj','p','go_id'])
for contrast in ['standard','starved']:

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("expected counts, layout, output")
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
out_path <- args[[3]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

if (grepl("\\.csv$", counts_path, ignore.case=TRUE)) {
  counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
} else {
  counts <- read.delim(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

required <- c("SampleID", "Group")
if (!all(required %in% colnames(layout))) stop("sample layout lacks SampleID/Group")
layout$matrix_id <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
if (sum(keep) != 6) stop("expected exactly three DMSO and three CBD_IC50 samples")
if (!all(layout$matrix_id[keep] %in% colnames(counts))) stop("layout samples do not match count matrix columns")

meta <- layout[keep, c("SampleID", "Group", "matrix_id")]
meta$condition <- factor(ifelse(meta$Group == "DMSO", "DMSO", "CBD"), levels=c("DMSO", "CBD"))
counts <- counts[, meta$matrix_id, drop=FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(colnames(counts), meta$matrix_id), , drop=FALSE]
if (anyNA(meta$condition) || anyNA(colnames(counts))) stop("sample matching failed")
rownames(meta) <- meta$matrix_id

counts <- as.matrix(counts)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric")
if (anyNA(counts) || any(!is.finite(counts)) || any(counts < 0)) stop("counts must be finite nonnegative numbers")
if (any(abs(counts - round(counts)) > 0)) stop("counts must be integer-valued")
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=meta, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD", "DMSO"), alpha=0.05)

out <- as.data.frame(res)
out$gene_id <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c("gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(out, file=out_path, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.layout.path)" de_results.tsv

set -eu
cat > run_deseq.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("expected counts, layout, output")
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
out_path <- args[[3]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

required <- c("SampleID", "Group")
if (!all(required %in% colnames(layout))) stop("sample layout lacks SampleID/Group")
layout$matrix_id <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
if (sum(keep) != 6) stop("expected exactly three DMSO and three CBD_IC50 samples")
if (!all(layout$matrix_id[keep] %in% colnames(counts))) stop("layout samples do not match count matrix columns")

meta <- layout[keep, c("SampleID", "Group", "matrix_id")]
meta$condition <- factor(ifelse(meta$Group == "DMSO", "DMSO", "CBD"), levels=c("DMSO", "CBD"))
counts <- counts[, meta$matrix_id, drop=FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(colnames(counts), meta$matrix_id), , drop=FALSE]
if (anyNA(meta$condition) || anyNA(colnames(counts))) stop("sample matching failed")
rownames(meta) <- meta$matrix_id

counts <- as.matrix(counts)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric")
if (anyNA(counts) || any(!is.finite(counts)) || any(counts < 0)) stop("counts must be finite nonnegative numbers")
if (any(abs(counts - round(counts)) > 0)) stop("counts must be integer-valued")
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=meta, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD", "DMSO"), alpha=0.05)

out <- as.data.frame(res)
out$gene_id <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c("gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(out, file=out_path, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")

version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

from pathlib import Path
import csv, os
base=Path('/workspace')
stage=base/'galaxy_stage'/'cbd_go_lists'
stage.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
contrast_files={
 'cbd_dmso':base/'de_cbd_dmso.tabular',
 'cbd_ss':base/'de_cbd_ss.tabular',
 'combo':base/'de_combo.tabular',
 'combo_ss':base/'de_combo_ss.tabular',
}
all_ids=[]
for key,path in contrast_files.items():
    rows=[]
    with path.open(newline='') as fh:
        reader=csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\\t')
        for row in reader:
            gid=row['GeneID']
            all_ids.append(gid) if key=='cbd_dmso' else None
            lfc=float(row['logFC']); fdr=float(row['FDR'])
            if fdr < 0.05 and lfc > 0.5: rows.append((gid,'up'))
            elif fdr < 0.05 and lfc < -0.5: rows.append((gid,'down'))
    for direction in ('up','down'):
        out=stage/f'{direction}_{key}_ensembl.txt'
        ids=[gid for gid,d in rows if d==direction]
        out.write_text('\\n'.join(ids)+'\\n', encoding='utf-8')
        print(out.name, len(ids))
universe=stage/'universe_ensembl.txt'
universe.write_text('\\n'.join(all_ids)+'\\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(universe.name, len(all_ids), len(set(all_ids)))
PY

# Metadata ordering matches count columns through the sample IDs embedded in sample_layout.

def run(treat, control):
    keep=(counts[[x for x in counts.columns if x.replace('_','-') in meta.index][meta.Group.isin([treat,control])]]>=10).sum(axis=1)>=3
    # The above indexing is deliberately replaced below with exact ordered sample list.

    dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=c, metadata=m[['condition']], design='~condition', refit_cooks=True, n_cpus=1, quiet=True)

import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
counts.index = counts.index.astype(str)
meta = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['count_id'] = meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
keep = meta['Group'].isin(['DMSO','CBD_IC50'])
meta2 = meta.loc[keep].copy().set_index('count_id')
meta2 = meta2.loc[counts.columns.intersection(meta2.index)]
# explicit order is control then target, with DMSO as reference
meta2['condition'] = pd.Categorical(meta2['Group'], categories=['DMSO','CBD_IC50'])
cts = counts.loc[:, meta2.index].astype('int64')
print('shape', cts.shape, meta2['condition'].tolist())
print('library', cts.sum(axis=0).to_dict())
# remove only all-zero structural rows, which cannot enter a count model
cts = cts.loc[cts.sum(axis=1)>0]

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=cts.T, metadata=meta2[['condition']], design='~condition', refit_cooks=True, n_cpus=1, quiet=True)
dds.deseq2()
stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, cooks_filter=True, independent_filter=True, quiet=True, n_cpus=1)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
meta = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['col'] = meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)

def run(groups, label):
    m = meta[meta.Group.isin(groups)].copy()
    # order DMSO/control first then CBD target; within group retain sample order
    m['condition'] = pd.Categorical(m.Group, categories=groups, ordered=True)
    c = counts[m['col']].T.copy()
    c.index = m['col'].values
    c.columns = counts.index.astype(str)
    print(label, 'counts', c.shape, 'groups', m.Group.value_counts().to_dict(), flush=True)
    t=time.time()
    dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=c, metadata=m.set_index('col')[['condition']], design='~condition', ref_level=['condition', groups[0]], quiet=True, n_cpus=1)
    dds.deseq2()
    print('fit sec', time.time()-t, flush=True)
    stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition',groups[1],groups[0]], alpha=0.05, quiet=True, n_cpus=1)
    stat.summary()
    res = stat.results_df.copy()
    # columns baseMean log2FoldChange lfcSE stat pvalue padj
    res['gene']=res.index
    valid=res.dropna(subset=['padj','log2FoldChange'])
    sig=valid[(valid.padj<0.05)&(valid.log2FoldChange.abs()>0.5)]
    up=sig[sig.log2FoldChange>0.5]
    down=sig[sig.log2FoldChange< -0.5]
    print(label, 'all valid', len(valid), 'sig',len(sig),'up',len(up),'down',len(down), flush=True)
    print('top up:\\n', up.sort_values(['padj','log2FoldChange'], ascending=[True,False])[['baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].head(10).to_string(), flush=True)
    print('top down:\\n', down.sort_values(['padj','log2FoldChange'], ascending=[True,True])[['baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].head(10).to_string(), flush=True)
    return res
run(['DMSO','CBD_IC50'],'regular')
run(['DMSO_Serum_starvation','CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'],'starved')

name: transcriptomics
description: Use for RNA-seq or miRNA differential expression, design and contrast semantics, shrinkage, target-gene extraction, gene annotation, ORA, GSEA, and pathway enrichment. Do not use for simple summaries or correlations over an already prepared expression matrix.
---

# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

## Differential Expression

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,
  or paired control with another baseline unless the task defines that contrast.

bp_go <- bp_go[bp_go"'$ONTOLOGY=='"'BP',]
run <- function(uni_ens) {
  ue <- unique(map"'$ENTREZID[map$ENSEMBL %in% uni_ens])
  fgu <- unique(map$ENTREZID[map$ENSEMBL %in% up]); fgd <- unique(map$ENTREZID[map$ENSEMBL %in% down])
  fgu <- fgu[fgu %in% ue]; fgd <- fgd[fgd %in% ue]
  g2g <- select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=ue, columns='"'GO', keytype='ENTREZID')
  g2g <- g2g["'!is.na(g2g$GO) & g2g$GO %in% bp_go$GOID,]
  tg <- lapply(split(g2g$ENTREZID,g2g$GO), unique)

    N<-length(ue); k<-length(fg)

    metup=if(is.null(su))0 else sum(su$GOID%in%metabolic_ids),
    metdown=if(is.null(sd))0 else sum(sd$GOID%in%metabolic_ids))
}

python3 << 'EOF'
import csv, os

# Read the counts file
with open('/workspace/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    rows = list(reader)

# First row is header: ["", "1_1", "1_2", ..., "10_3"]
header = rows[0]
sample_names = header[1:]  # ["1_1", "1_2", ..., "10_3"]

print(f"Number of samples: {len(sample_names)}")
print(f"Number of genes: {len(rows) - 1}")
print(f"Sample names: {sample_names}")

# Sample layout groups
# 1: Untreated, 2: Serum_starvation, 3: DMSO, 4: DMSO_Serum_starvation
# 5: Cisplatin_IC50, 6: Cisplatin_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h
# 7: CBD_IC50, 8: CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h
# 9: Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50, 10: Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h

# Create output directory
os.makedirs('/workspace/split_counts', exist_ok=True)

# Split into individual files (gene_id + count per sample)
for i, sample in enumerate(sample_names):
    col_idx = i + 1  # +1 because first column is gene ID
    outpath = f'/workspace/split_counts/{sample}.counts'
    with open(outpath, 'w') as out:
        writer = csv.writer(out, delimiter='\t')
        writer.writerow(['gene_id', 'count'])
        for row in rows[1:]:
            gene_id = row[0].strip('"')
            count = row[col_idx]
            writer.writerow([gene_id, count])

print("Individual count files written to /workspace/split_counts/")

# Also print sample layout groups for clarity
groups = {
    '1': 'Untreated', '2': 'Serum_starvation', '3': 'DMSO',
    '4': 'DMSO_Serum_starvation', '5': 'Cisplatin_IC50',
    '6': 'Cisplatin_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h', '7': 'CBD_IC50',
    '8': 'CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h', '9': 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50',
    '10': 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'
}
for sample in sample_names:
    group_num = sample.split('_')[0]
    print(f"  {sample} -> Group {group_num}: {groups[group_num]}")
EOF

import csv

# Read DESeq2 results
with open('/workspace/deseq2_results.tab', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter='\t')
    rows = list(reader)

# Columns: GeneID, baseMean, log2FC, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj
total_genes = len(rows)
print(f"Total genes tested: {total_genes}")

# Filter: padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.5
sig_genes = []
up_genes = []
down_genes = []

for row in rows:
    gene_id = row[0]
    log2fc = float(row[2])
    padj = float(row[6])
    
    if padj < 0.05 and abs(log2fc) > 0.5:
        sig_genes.append(row)
        if log2fc > 0.5:
            up_genes.append(gene_id)
        elif log2fc < -0.5:
            down_genes.append(gene_id)

print(f"Significant DE genes (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5): {len(sig_genes)}")
print(f"Up-regulated in CBD (log2FC > 0.5): {len(up_genes)}")
print(f"Down-regulated in CBD (log2FC < -0.5): {len(down_genes)}")

# Write up and down gene lists for GO enrichment
with open('/workspace/up_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(up_genes))
print(f"\nUp-regulated genes written to /workspace/up_genes.txt")

with open('/workspace/down_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(down_genes))
print(f"Down-regulated genes written to /workspace/down_genes.txt")

# Also write a combined background (all tested genes)
with open('/workspace/all_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    all_ids = [row[0] for row in rows]
    f.write('\n'.join(all_ids))
print(f"All genes (background) written to /workspace/all_genes.txt")

# Show top 10 up and down
print("\nTop 10 up-regulated:")

import csv

def get_go_metrics(filepath, label):
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
        rows = list(reader)
    
    go_bp = [r for r in rows if r['source'] == 'GO:BP']
    
    # Core metabolic keywords (more specific)
    core_metab = ['carbohydrate', 'glucose', 'glycolysis', 'pyruvate', 'TCA', 'citric', 
                  'lipid', 'fatty acid', 'cholesterol', 'monosaccharide', 'hexose',
                  'oxidative phosphorylation', 'respiratory chain', 'ATP metab',
                  'energy', 'organic acid', 'carboxylic acid', 'nucleotide',
                  'amino acid metab', 'catabolic', 'small molecule',
                  'mitochondr', 'NADH', 'NADPH', 'acetyl-CoA', 'beta-oxidation',
                  'monocarboxylic', 'oxoacid', 'ribonucleotide']
    
    core_metab_terms = []
    for r in go_bp:
        tn = r['term_name'].lower()
        for kw in core_metab:
            if kw.lower() in tn:
                core_metab_terms.append(r)
                break
    
    # Remove duplicates (by term_id)
    seen = set()
    unique_metab = []
    for r in sorted(core_metab_terms, key=lambda x: float(x['p_value'])):
        if r['term_id'] not in seen:
            seen.add(r['term_id'])
            unique_metab.append(r)
    
    return {
        'label': label,
        'total_bp': len(go_bp),
        'core_metab_count': len(unique_metab),
        'top_metab_terms': unique_metab[:15]
    }

up = get_go_metrics('/workspace/go_up_results.tab', 'UP')
down = get_go_metrics('/workspace/go_down_results.tab', 'DOWN')

print(f"\n--- Core Metabolic GO:BP Terms: UP-REGULATED ---")

    print(f"  p={float(r['p_value']):.2e}  {r['term_name']}")

# Conclusion
print(f"\n{'='*80}")
print("CONCLUSION:")
print(f"{'='*80}")
if down['core_metab_count'] > up['core_metab_count']:
    print(f"Downregulation primarily drives the metabolic effects ({down['core_metab_count']} vs {up['core_metab_count']} core metabolic terms).")

# Read the original sample layout and fix SampleID to use underscores
rows = []
with open('/workspace/sample_layout.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    rows.append(header)
    for row in reader:
        if len(row) >= 3:
            # Replace dashes with underscores in SampleID
            row[1] = row[1].replace('-', '_')
        rows.append(row)

# Write corrected version
with open('/workspace/sample_layout_corrected.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:

    writer.writerows(rows)

for row in rows[:5]:
    print(row)
print("...")
for row in rows[-3:]:

import csv
import os

# Read the count matrix
counts_data = {}
gene_ids = []
with open('/workspace/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    # Clean up header: first col is empty/gene name, rest are sample IDs
    col_names = [h.strip('"') for h in header]
    col_names[0] = 'gene_id'  # rename first column
    
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row[0].strip('"')
        if not gene_id:
            continue
        counts_data[gene_id] = {col_names[i]: row[i] for i in range(1, len(col_names))}

# Samples we need:
# DMSO: 3_1, 3_2, 3_3
# CBD_IC50: 7_1, 7_2, 7_3
samples = {
    'DMSO': ['3_1', '3_2', '3_3'],
    'CBD_IC50': ['7_1', '7_2', '7_3']
}

os.makedirs('/workspace/per_sample_counts', exist_ok=True)

for group, sample_list in samples.items():
    for sample in sample_list:
        filename = f'/workspace/per_sample_counts/{sample}.counts'
        with open(filename, 'w', newline='') as f:
            writer = csv.writer(f, delimiter='\t')
            writer.writerow(['gene_id', 'count'])
            for gene_id in counts_data:
                count = counts_data[gene_id].get(sample, '0')
                writer.writerow([gene_id, count])
        print(f"Created {filename} with {len(counts_data)} genes")

# Quick verification
for group, sample_list in samples.items():
    for sample in sample_list:
        filename = f'/workspace/per_sample_counts/{sample}.counts'
        with open(filename, 'r') as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
            print(f"  {sample}: {len(lines)} lines, first: {lines[0].strip()}, second: {lines[1].strip()}")

import yaml

udt = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "deseq2-cbd-vs-dmso",
    "name": "DESeq2 CBD vs DMSO",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/bioconductor-deseq2:1.50.2--r45ha27e39d_0",
    "requirements": [
        {"type": "resource", "cores_min": 4, "ram_min": 8}
    ],
    "shell_command": (
        'set -eu\n'
        'Rscript - "$(inputs.counts.path)" << \'REOF\'\n'
        'args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)\n'
        'counts_file <- args[1]\n'
        '\n'
        '# Read count matrix\n'
        'counts <- read.table(counts_file, header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep="\\t",\n'
        '                     check.names=FALSE, quote="\\"", comment.char="")\n'
        '\n'
        '# Select DMSO and CBD_IC50 columns\n'
        'dmso_cols <- c("3_1", "3_2", "3_3")\n'
        'cbd_cols <- c("7_1", "7_2", "7_3")\n'
        '\n'
        '# Verify columns exist\n'
        'stopifnot(all(dmso_cols %in% colnames(counts)))\n'
        'stopifnot(all(cbd_cols %in% colnames(counts)))\n'
        '\n'
        'counts_sub <- counts[, c(dmso_cols, cbd_cols)]\n'

        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass

sig = [r for r in results if r['padj'] is not None and r['log2FoldChange'] is not None 
       and r['padj'] < 0.05 and abs(r['log2FoldChange']) > 0.5]

down = [r for r in sig if r['log2FoldChange'] < -0.5]

print(f"  Upregulated (log2FC > 0.5): {len(up)}")
print(f"  Downregulated (log2FC < -0.5): {len(down)}")

# Gene ID is in first column (key '')
gene_id_key = ''
for r in results[:1]:
    print(f"Column keys: {list(r.keys())}")
    break

# Write gene lists
with open('/workspace/up_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    for r in up:
        f.write(r[gene_id_key] + '\n')

with open('/workspace/down_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    for r in down:
        f.write(r[gene_id_key] + '\n')

with open('/workspace/background_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    for r in results:
        if r[gene_id_key]:
            f.write(r[gene_id_key] + '\n')

# Top DE genes
up_sorted = sorted(up, key=lambda r: -r['log2FoldChange'])
print(f"\nTop 5 upregulated by log2FC:")
for r in up_sorted[:5]:
    print(f"  {r[gene_id_key]}: log2FC={r['log2FoldChange']:.3f}, padj={r['padj']:.2e}")

down_sorted = sorted(down, key=lambda r: r['log2FoldChange'])
print(f"\nTop 5 downregulated by log2FC:")
for r in down_sorted[:5]:
    print(f"  {r[gene_id_key]}: log2FC={r['log2FoldChange']:.3f}, padj={r['padj']:.2e}")

# Count background genes that could be tested (non-NA)
bg_valid = [r for r in results if r['padj'] is not None]
print(f"\nBackground genes with valid padj: {len(bg_valid)}")

events.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import base64, json
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = GalaxyInstance("https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)
history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b56417cac1b3ee29c7"

# R script for DESeq2
r_script = r'''
set -eu

# Read the count matrix
counts <- as.matrix(read.table("$(inputs.counts.path)", header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE))

# Ensure integer counts
counts <- round(counts)

# Define conditions: first 3 columns = DMSO, next 3 = CBD_IC50
condition <- factor(c(rep("DMSO", 3), rep("CBD_IC50", 3)))
col_data <- data.frame(row.names=colnames(counts), condition=condition)

# Build DESeq2 dataset
suppressMessages(library(DESeq2))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=col_data, design=~condition)

# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results: CBD_IC50 vs DMSO (CBD is numerator, DMSO is denominator)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"))
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
res <- res[, c("GeneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]

# Write results
write.table(res, file="deseq_results.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, na="NA")

python3 -c "
import csv

# Get upregulated, downregulated, and background gene lists
up_genes = []
down_genes = []
bg_genes = []

with open('/workspace/deseq_results.tsv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
    for row in reader:
        gene = row['GeneID']
        padj = row['padj']
        log2fc_str = row['log2FoldChange']
        
        # Background: genes with non-NA padj (these were tested)
        if padj != 'NA' and log2fc_str != 'NA' and row['baseMean'] != 'NA' and float(row['baseMean']) > 0:
            bg_genes.append(gene)
        
        if padj == 'NA' or log2fc_str == 'NA':
            continue
        
        padj_val = float(padj)
        log2fc_val = float(log2fc_str)
        
        if padj_val < 0.05:
            if log2fc_val > 0.5:
                up_genes.append(gene)
            elif log2fc_val < -0.5:
                down_genes.append(gene)

# Write as whitespace-separated single line for gProfiler
with open('/workspace/up_genes_gprofiler.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(' '.join(up_genes))

with open('/workspace/down_genes_gprofiler.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(' '.join(down_genes))

with open('/workspace/bg_genes_gprofiler.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(' '.join(bg_genes))

print(f'Upregulated: {len(up_genes)} genes')
print(f'Downregulated: {len(down_genes)} genes')
print(f'Background: {len(bg_genes)} genes')
"

python3 -c "
import csv

# Analyze metabolic GO terms in down vs up
def get_go_bp_terms(filepath):
    terms = []
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
        for row in reader:
            if row.get('source') == 'GO:BP' and row.get('significant') == 'TRUE':
                terms.append({
                    'name': row['term_name'],
                    'p_value': float(row['p_value']),
                    'intersection_size': int(row['intersection_size']),
                    'query_size': int(row['query_size'])
                })
    return terms

up_terms = get_go_bp_terms('/workspace/go_up_results.tsv')
down_terms = get_go_bp_terms('/workspace/go_down_results.tsv')

# Check for metabolic keywords
metabolic_keywords = ['metabolic', 'glycoly', 'glucose', 'hexose', 'monosaccharide', 
                       'carbohydrate', 'pyruvate', 'catabolic', 'nucleotide',
                       'energy', 'respiration', 'ATP', 'ADP', 'NAD', 'oxidative',
                       'lipid', 'fatty acid', 'amino acid', 'TCA', 'citrate',
                       'mitochondri', 'electron transport']

print('=== GO BP terms with metabolic keywords ===')
print()
print('DOWNREGULATED GENES (by CBD):')
for t in down_terms:
    name_lower = t['name'].lower()
    if any(kw.lower() in name_lower for kw in metabolic_keywords):
        print(f'  p={t[\"p_value\"]:.2e} | {t[\"intersection_size\"]}/{t[\"query_size\"]} | {t[\"name\"]}')

print()
print('UPREGULATED GENES (by CBD):')
for t in up_terms:
    name_lower = t['name'].lower()
    if any(kw.lower() in name_lower for kw in metabolic_keywords):
        print(f'  p={t[\"p_value\"]:.2e} | {t[\"intersection_size\"]}/{t[\"query_size\"]} | {t[\"name\"]}')

print()
print('=== Summary ===')
down_metabolic = sum(1 for t in down_terms if any(kw.lower() in t['name'].lower() for kw in metabolic_keywords))
up_metabolic = sum(1 for t in up_terms if any(kw.lower() in t['name'].lower() for kw in metabolic_keywords))
print(f'Downregulated: {len(down_terms)} total GO:BP terms, {down_metabolic} metabolic-related')
print(f'Upregulated: {len(up_terms)} total GO:BP terms, {up_metabolic} metabolic-related')

# Also compare top-level metabolic process coverage
print()
print('All downregulated GO:BP terms:')
for t in down_terms:
    print(f'  p={t[\"p_value\"]:.2e} | {t[\"intersection_size\"]}/{t[\"query_size\"]} | {t[\"name\"]}')" 

print()
print('All upregulated GO:BP terms:')
for t in up_terms:
    print(f'  p={t[\"p_value\"]:.2e} | {t[\"intersection_size\"]}/{t[\"query_size\"]} | {t[\"name\"]}')
"

counts <- as.matrix(read.table("/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78563173/inputs/dataset_6c9aee06-f81e-4b75-83c8-fd9cb2c49d40.dat", header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE))

condition <- factor(c(rep("DMSO", 3), rep("CBD_IC50", 3)))
col_data <- data.frame(row.names=colnames(counts), condition=condition)

suppressMessages(library(DESeq2))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=col_data, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"))
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
res <- res[, c("GeneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]

write.table(res, file="deseq_results.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, na="NA")
REOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Differential expression and GO enrichment analysis:
CBD_IC50 vs DMSO in CRC cells.
Determine whether upregulation or downregulation primarily drives metabolic effects.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
from goatools.obo_parser import GODag
from goatools.go_enrichment import GOEnrichmentStudy
from goatools.associations import read_gaf
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# ── 1. Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────

counts = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/sample_layout.csv')

print(f"Counts shape: {counts.shape}")
print(f"Layout shape: {layout.shape}")
print(f"Groups: {layout['Group'].unique()}")

# ── 2. Filter to CBD_IC50 vs DMSO ───────────────────────────────

# The cleanest comparison: CBD_IC50 (group 7) vs DMSO vehicle (group 3)
cbd_samples = layout[layout['Group'] == 'CBD_IC50']['SampleID'].values
dmso_samples = layout[layout['Group'] == 'DMSO']['SampleID'].values

print(f"CBD_IC50 samples: {cbd_samples}")
print(f"DMSO samples: {dmso_samples}")

# Map SampleID to column names in counts
# Counts columns are like "1_1", "1_2", etc. SampleID is like "1-1", "1-2"
# Need to convert dashes to underscores
cbd_cols = [s.replace('-', '_') for s in cbd_samples]
dmso_cols = [s.replace('-', '_') for s in dmso_samples]

all_cols = cbd_cols + dmso_cols
print(f"CBD columns: {cbd_cols}")
print(f"DMSO columns: {dmso_cols}")

# Subset counts matrix
counts_sub = counts[all_cols].copy()

# Filter low-expressed genes: keep genes with >= 10 total counts across all samples
counts_sub = counts_sub[counts_sub.sum(axis=1) >= 10]

# Create metadata
metadata = pd.DataFrame({
    'sample': all_cols,
    'condition': ['CBD'] * len(cbd_cols) + ['DMSO'] * len(dmso_cols)
})
metadata = metadata.set_index('sample')

print(f"\nFiltered counts shape: {counts_sub.shape}")
print(f"Metadata:\n{metadata}")

# ── 3. Run DESeq2 ───────────────────────────────────────────────

dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_sub.T,
    metadata=metadata,
    design_factors='condition',
    refit_cooks=True,
)

# Set reference level to DMSO
dds.condition = dds.condition.cat.reorder_categories(['DMSO', 'CBD'])

dds.deseq2()

# Extract results for CBD vs DMSO
stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=('condition', 'CBD', 'DMSO'))
stat_res.summary()

results = stat_res.results_df.copy()
results = results.sort_values('padj')

# Apply thresholds
results['significant'] = (results['padj'] < 0.05) & (abs(results['log2FoldChange']) > 0.5)
results['direction'] = np.where(
    results['significant'],
    np.where(results['log2FoldChange'] > 0.5, 'up', 'down'),
    'ns'
)

print(f"\nDE Results:")
print(f"Total genes tested: {len(results)}")
print(f"Significant (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5): {results['significant'].sum()}")
print(f"Upregulated: {(results['direction'] == 'up').sum()}")
print(f"Downregulated: {(results['direction'] == 'down').sum()}")

# Save for inspection
up_genes = results[results['direction'] == 'up'].index.tolist()
down_genes = results[results['direction'] == 'down'].index.tolist()

print(f"\nUp genes (first 10): {up_genes[:10]}")
print(f"Down genes (first 10): {down_genes[:10]}")

# ── 4. GO Enrichment Analysis ───────────────────────────────────

# Download GO files if not present
import os
import gzip
import urllib.request

go_dir = '/workspace/go_data'
os.makedirs(go_dir, exist_ok=True)

# GO OBO file
go_obo_path = os.path.join(go_dir, 'go-basic.obo')
if not os.path.exists(go_obo_path):
    print("\nDownloading GO ontology...")
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(
        'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/go/go-basic.obo',
        go_obo_path
    )

# GOA human file
goa_path = os.path.join(go_dir, 'goa_human.gaf.gz')
if not os.path.exists(goa_path):
    print("Downloading GOA human annotations...")
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(
        'http://geneontology.org/gene-associations/goa_human.gaf.gz',
        goa_path
    )

# Load GO DAG
godag = GODag(go_obo_path)

# Load gene-to-GO associations
# We need to map ENSG IDs to UniProtKB accessions or use the gene symbol mapping
# The GAF file uses UniProtKB accessions; we need to map ENSG to those.
# Alternative: use a simpler approach with direct GO term-gene mapping.

# Let's use a more direct approach: build the background gene set and do
# enrichment using ENSG-to-GO mappings from Ensembl BioMart or precomputed mappings.

print("\nLoading GO associations...")

# Parse GAF to get gene-GO mappings (using UniProt IDs)
# Need to map ENSG to UniProt. Let's use the gene names directly from the ENSG IDs
# or use the mygene package.

# Simpler approach: use g:Profiler or enrichr APIs, or do Fisher's exact test
# with precomputed GO-gene sets.

# Let's map ENSG IDs to gene symbols using mygene or a local mapping,
# then use GOATOOLS with the symbol-based annotation.

# Actually, let me try a different approach - use clusterProfiler-like analysis
# by downloading GO term gene sets or using the GOATOOLS library properly.

# First, map ENSG to Entrez gene IDs using mygene
from goatools.base import download_ncbi_associations
# This downloads gene2go which maps NCBI Gene IDs to GO terms

# Download the gene2go file from NCBI
gene2go_path = os.path.join(go_dir, 'gene2go')
if not os.path.exists(gene2go_path):
    print("Downloading NCBI gene2go...")
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(
        'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/gene2go.gz',
        gene2go_path + '.gz'
    )
    with gzip.open(gene2go_path + '.gz', 'rb') as f_in:
        with open(gene2go_path, 'wb') as f_out:
            f_out.write(f_in.read())

# We also need the gene_info file to map ENSG to Entrez Gene ID
gene_info_path = os.path.join(go_dir, 'gene_info')
if not os.path.exists(gene_info_path):
    print("Downloading NCBI gene_info (human)...")
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(
        'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/GENE_INFO/Mammalia/Homo_sapiens.gene_info.gz',
        gene_info_path + '.gz'
    )
    with gzip.open(gene_info_path + '.gz', 'rb') as f_in:
        with open(gene_info_path, 'wb') as f_out:
            f_out.write(f_in.read())

# Parse gene_info to map ENSG -> Entrez Gene ID
print("Mapping ENSG to Entrez Gene IDs...")
ensg2entrez = {}
entrez2ensg = {}
with open(gene_info_path) as f:
    header = None
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if header is None:
            header = parts
            # Find relevant columns
            tax_idx = header.index('#tax_id')
            gene_id_idx = header.index('GeneID')
            dbxrefs_idx = header.index('dbXrefs')
            continue
        if parts[tax_idx] != '9606':  # human only
            continue
        entrez_id = parts[gene_id_idx]
        dbxrefs = parts[dbxrefs_idx]
        # Look for Ensembl ID in dbXrefs
        for xref in dbxrefs.split('|'):
            if xref.startswith('Ensembl:'):
                ensg = xref.replace('Ensembl:', '')
                ensg2entrez[ensg] = entrez_id
                if entrez_id not in entrez2ensg:
                    entrez2ensg[entrez_id] = []
                entrez2ensg[entrez_id].append(ensg)
                break

print(f"Mapped {len(ensg2entrez)} ENSG IDs to Entrez IDs")

# Parse gene2go to get Entrez -> GO term mappings
print("Parsing gene2go...")
entrez2go = {}
go2entrez = {}
with open(gene2go_path) as f:
    header = None
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if header is None:
            header = parts
            tax_idx = header.index('#tax_id')
            gene_id_idx = header.index('GeneID')
            go_id_idx = header.index('GO_ID')
            category_idx = header.index('Category')
            continue
        if parts[tax_idx] != '9606':
            continue
        category = parts[category_idx]
        if category != 'Process':  # Biological Process only
            continue
        entrez_id = parts[gene_id_idx]
        go_id = parts[go_id_idx]
        if entrez_id not in entrez2go:
            entrez2go[entrez_id] = set()
        entrez2go[entrez_id].add(go_id)
        if go_id not in go2entrez:
            go2entrez[go_id] = set()
        go2entrez[go_id].add(entrez_id)

print(f"Parsed {len(entrez2go)} Entrez genes with GO BP annotations")
print(f"Parsed {len(go2entrez)} GO BP terms")

# ── 5. Run GO enrichment ────────────────────────────────────────

def run_go_enrichment(gene_list_ensg, background_ensg, go2entrez, entrez2go, ensg2entrez, godag, label):
    """Run Fisher's exact test for GO BP enrichment."""

    # Convert ENSG to Entrez
    entrez_list = set()
    for ensg in gene_list_ensg:
        if ensg in ensg2entrez:
            entrez_list.add(ensg2entrez[ensg])

    background_entrez = set()
    for ensg in background_ensg:
        if ensg in ensg2entrez:
            background_entrez.add(ensg2entrez[ensg])

    print(f"\n{label}: {len(gene_list_ensg)} ENSG -> {len(entrez_list)} Entrez IDs")
    print(f"Background: {len(background_ensg)} ENSG -> {len(background_entrez)} Entrez IDs")

    # For each GO term, compute enrichment
    results = []
    for go_id, go_genes in go2entrez.items():
        # Ensure GO term exists in DAG
        if go_id not in godag:
            continue

        # Study set genes annotated to this term
        study_annotated = len(entrez_list & go_genes)
        if study_annotated < 2:  # minimum 2 genes
            continue

        # Contingency table
        a = study_annotated  # study genes with GO term
        b = len(entrez_list) - a  # study genes without GO term
        c = len(background_entrez & go_genes) - a  # background genes with GO term (excluding study)
        d = len(background_entrez) - len(entrez_list) - c  # rest

        if c < 0 or d < 0:
            continue

        # Fisher's exact test
        table = [[a, b], [c, d]]
        odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact(table, alternative='greater')

        go_name = godag[go_id].name if go_id in godag else go_id

        results.append({
            'GO_ID': go_id,
            'GO_Name': go_name,
            'Study_Genes': a,
            'Study_Total': len(entrez_list),
            'BG_Genes': len(background_entrez & go_genes),
            'BG_Total': len(background_entrez),
            'P_value': p_value,
            'Odds_Ratio': odds_ratio,
        })

    if not results:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
    results_df = results_df.sort_values('P_value')

    # Benjamini-Hochberg correction
    from scipy.stats import false_discovery_control
    n = len(results_df)
    # Manual BH correction
    results_df['P_rank'] = results_df['P_value'].rank(method='min')
    results_df['P_adj'] = results_df['P_value'] * n / results_df['P_rank']
    results_df['P_adj'] = results_df['P_adj'].clip(upper=1.0)
    results_df = results_df.sort_values('P_adj')

    # Filter significant
    sig = results_df[results_df['P_adj'] < 0.05]

    return results_df, sig

# Background: all genes tested in DE analysis
background_genes = results.index.tolist()

up_results, up_sig = run_go_enrichment(
    up_genes, background_genes, go2entrez, entrez2go, ensg2entrez, godag, "UP-regulated"
)

down_results, down_sig = run_go_enrichment(
    down_genes, background_genes, go2entrez, entrez2go, ensg2entrez, godag, "DOWN-regulated"
)

# ── 6. Analyze metabolic GO terms ───────────────────────────────

# Define metabolic-related keywords
metabolic_keywords = [
    'metabolic', 'metabolism', 'catabolic', 'catabolism', 'anabolic', 'anabolism',
    'glycolysis', 'glycolytic', 'gluconeogenesis', 'tca cycle', 'citric acid cycle',
    'tricarboxylic acid', 'krebs cycle', 'oxidative phosphorylation',
    'electron transport chain', 'respiratory chain', 'atp synthesis',
    'lipid metabo', 'lipid biosynth', 'lipid catabol', 'fatty acid',
    'cholesterol', 'triglyceride', 'phospholipid',
    'amino acid metabo', 'amino acid catabol', 'amino acid biosynth',
    'protein metabo', 'protein catabol', 'protein biosynth',
    'carbohydrate metabo', 'carbohydrate catabol', 'carbohydrate biosynth',
    'glucose metabo', 'glucose transport', 'glucose homeostasis',
    'nucleotide metabo', 'nucleotide biosynth', 'nucleotide catabol',
    'energy', 'mitochondr', 'redox', 'nad', 'nadh', 'fad', 'nadph',
    'ros', 'reactive oxygen', 'oxidative stress',
    'autophagy', 'phagosome', 'lysosome',
    'insulin', 'glucagon', 'mTOR', 'AMPK', 'sirtuin',
    'acetyl-CoA', 'acetylation',
    'xenobiotic', 'drug metabo', 'detoxif',
    'steroid', 'sterol',
]

def filter_metabolic_terms(results_df, keywords):
    """Filter GO terms to metabolic-related ones."""
    if results_df.empty:
        return results_df
    mask = pd.Series(False, index=results_df.index)
    for kw in keywords:
        # Case-insensitive match on GO name
        mask = mask | results_df['GO_Name'].str.lower().str.contains(kw, na=False)
    return results_df[mask]

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("METABOLIC-RELATED GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS TERMS")
print("="*80)

print(f"\n--- Up-regulated genes ({len(up_genes)} genes) ---")
up_metabolic_all = filter_metabolic_terms(up_results, metabolic_keywords)
print(f"Metabolic-related terms tested: {len(up_metabolic_all)}")
up_metabolic_sig = up_metabolic_all[up_metabolic_all['P_adj'] < 0.05]
print(f"Significant metabolic terms: {len(up_metabolic_sig)}")
if len(up_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    print(up_metabolic_sig[['GO_ID', 'GO_Name', 'Study_Genes', 'P_adj', 'Odds_Ratio']].to_string())
    print(f"\nTop 10 metabolic terms (all):")
    print(up_metabolic_all.head(10)[['GO_ID', 'GO_Name', 'Study_Genes', 'P_adj', 'Odds_Ratio']].to_string())

print(f"\n--- Down-regulated genes ({len(down_genes)} genes) ---")
down_metabolic_all = filter_metabolic_terms(down_results, metabolic_keywords)
print(f"Metabolic-related terms tested: {len(down_metabolic_all)}")
down_metabolic_sig = down_metabolic_all[down_metabolic_all['P_adj'] < 0.05]
print(f"Significant metabolic terms: {len(down_metabolic_sig)}")
if len(down_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    print(down_metabolic_sig[['GO_ID', 'GO_Name', 'Study_Genes', 'P_adj', 'Odds_Ratio']].to_string())
    print(f"\nTop 10 metabolic terms (all):")
    print(down_metabolic_all.head(10)[['GO_ID', 'GO_Name', 'Study_Genes', 'P_adj', 'Odds_Ratio']].to_string())

# ── 7. Comprehensive comparison ─────────────────────────────────

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("COMPREHENSIVE COMPARISON: UP vs DOWN metabolic impact")
print("="*80)

# Multiple criteria:
# 1. Number of significant metabolic GO terms
# 2. Enrichment strength (odds ratios) of metabolic terms
# 3. Number of metabolic genes in each set
# 4. Average -log10(padj) of top metabolic terms

# Count metabolic genes
up_metabolic_genes = set()
for ensg in up_genes:
    if ensg in ensg2entrez:
        entrez = ensg2entrez[ensg]
        go_terms = entrez2go.get(entrez, set())
        for go_id in go_terms:
            if go_id in godag:
                go_name = godag[go_id].name.lower()
                for kw in metabolic_keywords:
                    if kw.lower() in go_name:
                        up_metabolic_genes.add(ensg)
                        break

down_metabolic_genes = set()
for ensg in down_genes:
    if ensg in ensg2entrez:
        entrez = ensg2entrez[ensg]
        go_terms = entrez2go.get(entrez, set())
        for go_id in go_terms:
            if go_id in godag:
                go_name = godag[go_id].name.lower()
                for kw in metabolic_keywords:
                    if kw.lower() in go_name:
                        down_metabolic_genes.add(ensg)
                        break

print(f"\nUp-regulated genes with metabolic GO annotations: {len(up_metabolic_genes)}")
print(f"Down-regulated genes with metabolic GO annotations: {len(down_metabolic_genes)}")

print(f"\nSignificant metabolic GO BP terms (padj<0.05):")
print(f"  Up-regulated enrichment: {len(up_metabolic_sig)}")
print(f"  Down-regulated enrichment: {len(down_metabolic_sig)}")

if len(up_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    print(f"\n  Up median odds ratio: {up_metabolic_sig['Odds_Ratio'].median():.2f}")
    print(f"  Up mean -log10(padj): {(-np.log10(up_metabolic_sig['P_adj'])).mean():.2f}")
    print(f"  Up top term: {up_metabolic_sig.iloc[0]['GO_Name']} (padj={up_metabolic_sig.iloc[0]['P_adj']:.2e})")

if len(down_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    print(f"\n  Down median odds ratio: {down_metabolic_sig['Odds_Ratio'].median():.2f}")
    print(f"  Down mean -log10(padj): {(-np.log10(down_metabolic_sig['P_adj'])).mean():.2f}")
    print(f"  Down top term: {down_metabolic_sig.iloc[0]['GO_Name']} (padj={down_metabolic_sig.iloc[0]['P_adj']:.2e})")

# ── 8. Also look at broader enrichment beyond just "metabolic" keywords ──

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("TOP GO BP TERMS (ALL) - OVERALL ENRICHMENT PATTERN")
print("="*80)

print(f"\nTop 15 up-regulated GO BP terms:")
up_top = up_results.head(15)
for _, row in up_top.iterrows():
    print(f"  {row['GO_Name']}: {row['Study_Genes']} genes, padj={row['P_adj']:.2e}, OR={row['Odds_Ratio']:.2f}")

print(f"\nTop 15 down-regulated GO BP terms:")
down_top = down_results.head(15)
for _, row in down_top.iterrows():
    print(f"  {row['GO_Name']}: {row['Study_Genes']} genes, padj={row['P_adj']:.2e}, OR={row['Odds_Ratio']:.2f}")

# ── 9. Final determination ──────────────────────────────────────

# Compare metabolic impact using multiple metrics
up_score = 0
down_score = 0

# Metric 1: Number of significant metabolic terms
if len(up_metabolic_sig) > len(down_metabolic_sig):
    up_score += 1
    print(f"\nMetric 1 (sig terms): UP wins ({len(up_metabolic_sig)} vs {len(down_metabolic_sig)})")
elif len(down_metabolic_sig) > len(up_metabolic_sig):
    down_score += 1
    print(f"\nMetric 1 (sig terms): DOWN wins ({len(down_metabolic_sig)} vs {len(up_metabolic_sig)})")
else:
    print(f"\nMetric 1 (sig terms): TIE ({len(up_metabolic_sig)} each)")

# Metric 2: Best p-value
if len(up_metabolic_sig) > 0 and len(down_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    if up_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min() < down_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min():
        up_score += 1
        print(f"Metric 2 (best padj): UP wins ({up_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min():.2e} vs {down_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min():.2e})")
    elif down_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min() < up_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min():
        down_score += 1
        print(f"Metric 2 (best padj): DOWN wins ({down_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min():.2e} vs {up_metabolic_sig['P_adj'].min():.2e})")
elif len(up_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    up_score += 1
    print(f"Metric 2 (best padj): UP wins (only up has sig terms)")
elif len(down_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    down_score += 1
    print(f"Metric 2 (best padj): DOWN wins (only down has sig terms)")

# Metric 3: Number of metabolic genes
if len(up_metabolic_genes) > len(down_metabolic_genes):
    up_score += 1
    print(f"Metric 3 (metabolic genes): UP wins ({len(up_metabolic_genes)} vs {len(down_metabolic_genes)})")
elif len(down_metabolic_genes) > len(up_metabolic_genes):
    down_score += 1
    print(f"Metric 3 (metabolic genes): DOWN wins ({len(down_metabolic_genes)} vs {len(up_metabolic_genes)})")
else:
    print(f"Metric 3 (metabolic genes): TIE ({len(up_metabolic_genes)} each)")

# Metric 4: Average enrichment strength (odds ratio > 2)
if len(up_metabolic_all) > 0 and len(down_metabolic_all) > 0:
    up_strong = (up_metabolic_all['Odds_Ratio'] > 2).sum()
    down_strong = (down_metabolic_all['Odds_Ratio'] > 2).sum()
    if up_strong > down_strong:
        up_score += 1
        print(f"Metric 4 (strong enrichment OR>2): UP wins ({up_strong} vs {down_strong})")
    elif down_strong > up_strong:
        down_score += 1
        print(f"Metric 4 (strong enrichment OR>2): DOWN wins ({down_strong} vs {down_strong})")

# Metric 5: Total significant GO terms (all categories)
up_sig_all = up_results[up_results['P_adj'] < 0.05]
down_sig_all = down_results[down_results['P_adj'] < 0.05]
if len(up_sig_all) > len(down_sig_all):
    up_score += 1
    print(f"Metric 5 (total sig terms): UP wins ({len(up_sig_all)} vs {len(down_sig_all)})")
elif len(down_sig_all) > len(up_sig_all):
    down_score += 1
    print(f"Metric 5 (total sig terms): DOWN wins ({len(down_sig_all)} vs {len(up_sig_all)})")

print(f"\n{'='*80}")
print(f"FINAL SCORE: Up={up_score}, Down={down_score}")
print(f"{'='*80}")

if up_score > down_score:
    conclusion = "upregulation"
elif down_score > up_score:
    conclusion = "downregulation"
else:
    # Tie-breaking: use metabolic gene count
    if len(up_metabolic_genes) > len(down_metabolic_genes):
        conclusion = "upregulation"
    elif len(down_metabolic_genes) > len(up_metabolic_genes):
        conclusion = "downregulation"
    else:
        # Second tie-break: which has more significant terms overall
        if len(up_sig_all) > len(down_sig_all):
            conclusion = "upregulation"
        else:
            conclusion = "downregulation"

print(f"\nCONCLUSION: {conclusion} primarily drives the metabolic effects of CBD treatment in CRC cells.")

# Save conclusion
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(conclusion + '\n')

print(f"\nAnswer written to /workspace/codex_output/answer.txt")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Differential expression and GO enrichment analysis:
CBD_IC50 vs DMSO in CRC cells.
Determine whether upregulation or downregulation primarily drives metabolic effects.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# ── 1. Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────

counts = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/sample_layout.csv')

print(f"Counts shape: {counts.shape}")
print(f"Layout shape: {layout.shape}")

# ── 2. Filter to CBD_IC50 vs DMSO ───────────────────────────────

cbd_samples = layout[layout['Group'] == 'CBD_IC50']['SampleID'].values
dmso_samples = layout[layout['Group'] == 'DMSO']['SampleID'].values

print(f"CBD_IC50 samples: {cbd_samples}")
print(f"DMSO samples: {dmso_samples}")

cbd_cols = [s.replace('-', '_') for s in cbd_samples]
dmso_cols = [s.replace('-', '_') for s in dmso_samples]
all_cols = cbd_cols + dmso_cols

counts_sub = counts[all_cols].copy()
counts_sub = counts_sub[counts_sub.sum(axis=1) >= 10]

metadata = pd.DataFrame({
    'sample': all_cols,
    'condition': ['CBD'] * len(cbd_cols) + ['DMSO'] * len(dmso_cols)
}).set_index('sample')

print(f"\nFiltered counts shape: {counts_sub.shape}")

# ── 3. Run DESeq2 ───────────────────────────────────────────────

from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_sub.T,
    metadata=metadata,
    design='~condition',
    refit_cooks=True,
)
dds.deseq2()

stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition', 'CBD', 'DMSO'])
stat_res.summary()

results = stat_res.results_df.copy()

# Apply thresholds
results['significant'] = (results['padj'] < 0.05) & (abs(results['log2FoldChange']) > 0.5)
results['direction'] = np.where(
    results['significant'],
    np.where(results['log2FoldChange'] > 0.5, 'up', 'down'),
    'ns'
)

print(f"\nDE Results:")
print(f"Total genes tested: {len(results)}")
print(f"Significant: {results['significant'].sum()}")
print(f"Upregulated: {(results['direction'] == 'up').sum()}")
print(f"Downregulated: {(results['direction'] == 'down').sum()}")

up_ensg = results[results['direction'] == 'up'].index.tolist()
down_ensg = results[results['direction'] == 'down'].index.tolist()
all_ensg = results.index.tolist()

print(f"First 5 up: {up_ensg[:5]}")
print(f"First 5 down: {down_ensg[:5]}")

# ── 4. Map ENSG to gene symbols (for Enrichr) ───────────────────

print("\nMapping ENSG IDs to gene symbols via mygene...")
import mygene
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()

# Query in batches to avoid timeouts
def batch_query(ensg_list, batch_size=500):
    symbols = {}
    entrez_ids = {}
    for i in range(0, len(ensg_list), batch_size):
        batch = ensg_list[i:i+batch_size]
        try:
            result = mg.querymany(batch, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol,entrezgene',
                                  species='human', returnall=True, as_dataframe=False)
            # Handle return format
            out_list = result.get('out', result) if isinstance(result, dict) else result
            for item in out_list:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    q = item.get('query', '')
                    sym = item.get('symbol', None)
                    ent = item.get('entrezgene', None)
                    if sym:
                        symbols[q] = sym
                    if ent:
                        entrez_ids[q] = str(ent)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  Batch {i//batch_size} error: {e}")
            continue
    return symbols, entrez_ids

all_syms, all_entrez = batch_query(all_ensg)

up_syms = [all_syms.get(g, g) for g in up_ensg if g in all_syms]
down_syms = [all_syms.get(g, g) for g in down_ensg if g in all_syms]
bg_syms = [all_syms.get(g, g) for g in all_ensg if g in all_syms]

print(f"Up genes mapped to symbols: {len(up_syms)}/{len(up_ensg)}")
print(f"Down genes mapped to symbols: {len(down_syms)}/{len(down_ensg)}")
print(f"Background genes mapped: {len(bg_syms)}/{len(all_ensg)}")

# ── 5. GO Biological Process Enrichment via Enrichr ─────────────

print("\nRunning GO Biological Process enrichment via Enrichr...")
import gseapy as gp

# Run enrichment for up-regulated genes
print(f"\nUp-regulated enrichment ({len(up_syms)} genes)...")
try:
    up_enr = gp.enrichr(
        gene_list=up_syms,
        gene_sets='GO_Biological_Process_2023',
        organism='human',
        outdir=None,
        no_plot=True,
    )
    up_enr_df = up_enr.results if hasattr(up_enr, 'results') else up_enr
    if isinstance(up_enr_df, pd.DataFrame):
        up_enr_df = up_enr_df.sort_values('Adjusted P-value')
        print(f"  Total terms: {len(up_enr_df)}")
        print(f"  Significant (padj<0.05): {(up_enr_df['Adjusted P-value'] < 0.05).sum()}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  Enrichr error for up: {e}")
    up_enr_df = pd.DataFrame()

# Run enrichment for down-regulated genes
print(f"\nDown-regulated enrichment ({len(down_syms)} genes)...")
try:
    down_enr = gp.enrichr(
        gene_list=down_syms,
        gene_sets='GO_Biological_Process_2023',
        organism='human',
        outdir=None,
        no_plot=True,
    )
    down_enr_df = down_enr.results if hasattr(down_enr, 'results') else down_enr
    if isinstance(down_enr_df, pd.DataFrame):
        down_enr_df = down_enr_df.sort_values('Adjusted P-value')
        print(f"  Total terms: {len(down_enr_df)}")
        print(f"  Significant (padj<0.05): {(down_enr_df['Adjusted P-value'] < 0.05).sum()}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  Enrichr error for down: {e}")

    'tricarboxylic acid', 'krebs cycle', 'oxidative phosphorylation',
    'electron transport chain', 'respiratory chain', 'atp synthesis',
    'lipid metabo', 'lipid biosynth', 'lipid catabol', 'fatty acid',
    'cholesterol', 'triglyceride', 'phospholipid',
    'amino acid metabo', 'amino acid catabol', 'amino acid biosynth',
    'protein metabo', 'protein catabol', 'protein biosynth',
    'carbohydrate metabo', 'carbohydrate catabol', 'carbohydrate biosynth',
    'glucose metabo', 'glucose transport', 'glucose homeostasis',
    'nucleotide metabo', 'nucleotide biosynth', 'nucleotide catabol',
    'energy', 'mitochondr', 'redox', 'nad', 'nadh', 'fad', 'nadph',
    'ros', 'reactive oxygen', 'oxidative stress',
    'autophagy', 'phagosome', 'lysosome',
    'insulin', 'glucagon', 'mtor', 'ampk', 'sirtuin',
    'acetyl-coa', 'acetylation',
    'xenobiotic', 'drug metabo', 'detoxif',
    'steroid', 'sterol',
]

def filter_metabolic(df, keywords):
    if df.empty:
        return df
    mask = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    for kw in keywords:
        mask = mask | df['Term'].str.lower().str.contains(kw, na=False)
    return df[mask]

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("METABOLIC-RELATED GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS TERMS")
print("="*80)

up_metabolic = filter_metabolic(up_enr_df, metabolic_keywords)
down_metabolic = filter_metabolic(down_enr_df, metabolic_keywords)

up_metabolic_sig = up_metabolic[up_metabolic['Adjusted P-value'] < 0.05] if not up_metabolic.empty else pd.DataFrame()
down_metabolic_sig = down_metabolic[down_metabolic['Adjusted P-value'] < 0.05] if not down_metabolic.empty else pd.DataFrame()

print(f"\nUp-regulated metabolic terms (all): {len(up_metabolic)}")
print(f"Up-regulated metabolic terms (sig, padj<0.05): {len(up_metabolic_sig)}")
if len(up_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    cols = ['Term', 'Overlap', 'Adjusted P-value', 'Odds Ratio', 'Combined Score']
    available = [c for c in cols if c in up_metabolic_sig.columns]
    print(up_metabolic_sig[available].head(20).to_string())

print(f"\nDown-regulated metabolic terms (all): {len(down_metabolic)}")
print(f"Down-regulated metabolic terms (sig, padj<0.05): {len(down_metabolic_sig)}")
if len(down_metabolic_sig) > 0:
    cols = ['Term', 'Overlap', 'Adjusted P-value', 'Odds Ratio', 'Combined Score']
    available = [c for c in cols if c in down_metabolic_sig.columns]
    print(down_metabolic_sig[available].head(20).to_string())

# ── 7. Also check overall top GO terms ─────────────────────────

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("TOP 20 GO BP TERMS - OVERALL ENRICHMENT")
print("="*80)

print(f"\nUp-regulated top 20:")
if not up_enr_df.empty:
    cols = ['Term', 'Overlap', 'Adjusted P-value', 'Odds Ratio', 'Combined Score']
    available = [c for c in cols if c in up_enr_df.columns]
    for i, (_, row) in enumerate(up_enr_df.head(20).iterrows()):
        is_met = False
        for kw in metabolic_keywords:
            if kw.lower() in str(row['Term']).lower():
                is_met = True
                break
        tag = " [METABOLIC]" if is_met else ""
        print(f"  {row['Term']}: padj={row['Adjusted P-value']:.2e}, OR={row.get('Odds Ratio', 'N/A')}{tag}")

print(f"\nDown-regulated top 20:")
if not down_enr_df.empty:
    cols = ['Term', 'Overlap', 'Adjusted P-value', 'Odds Ratio', 'Combined Score']
    available = [c for c in cols if c in down_enr_df.columns]
    for i, (_, row) in enumerate(down_enr_df.head(20).iterrows()):
        is_met = False
        for kw in metabolic_keywords:
            if kw.lower() in str(row['Term']).lower():
                is_met = True
                break
        tag = " [METABOLIC]" if is_met else ""
        print(f"  {row['Term']}: padj={row['Adjusted P-value']:.2e}, OR={row.get('Odds Ratio', 'N/A')}{tag}")

# ── 8. Quantitative comparison ──────────────────────────────────

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("QUANTITATIVE COMPARISON: UP vs DOWN metabolic impact")
print("="*80)

# Compute scores
metrics = {}

# Metric 1: Count of significant metabolic GO BP terms
metrics['sig_metabolic_terms'] = {
    'up': len(up_metabolic_sig),
    'down': len(down_metabolic_sig)
}

# Metric 2: Best (lowest) padj among metabolic terms
if not up_metabolic_sig.empty:
    metrics['best_metabolic_padj'] = {
        'up': up_metabolic_sig['Adjusted P-value'].min(),
        'down': down_metabolic_sig['Adjusted P-value'].min() if not down_metabolic_sig.empty else 1.0
    }
elif not down_metabolic_sig.empty:
    metrics['best_metabolic_padj'] = {
        'up': 1.0,
        'down': down_metabolic_sig['Adjusted P-value'].min()
    }

# Metric 3: Count of metabolic terms with Combined Score > 10
if not up_metabolic.empty and 'Combined Score' in up_metabolic.columns:
    metrics['strong_metabolic_enrichment'] = {
        'up': (up_metabolic['Combined Score'] > 10).sum(),
        'down': (down_metabolic['Combined Score'] > 10).sum() if not down_metabolic.empty else 0
    }

# Metric 4: Total significant GO BP terms (all)
metrics['sig_all_terms'] = {
    'up': (up_enr_df['Adjusted P-value'] < 0.05).sum() if not up_enr_df.empty else 0,
    'down': (down_enr_df['Adjusted P-value'] < 0.05).sum() if not down_enr_df.empty else 0

if not up_metabolic.empty and 'Combined Score' in up_metabolic.columns:
    metrics['avg_metabolic_score'] = {
        'up': up_metabolic['Combined Score'].mean(),

    }

    if up_val > down_val:

        up_wins += 1
    elif down_val > up_val:
        winner = 'DOWN'
        down_wins += 1
    else:
        winner = 'TIE'
    print(f"\n{metric_name}: UP={up_val:.4g}, DOWN={down_val:.4g} -> {winner}")

if 'best_metabolic_padj' in metrics:

    if bp['up'] < bp['down']:
        print(f"best_metabolic_padj (lower=better): UP={bp['up']:.2e}, DOWN={bp['down']:.2e} -> UP wins")
        up_wins += 1
    elif bp['down'] < bp['up']:
        print(f"best_metabolic_padj (lower=better): UP={bp['up']:.2e}, DOWN={bp['down']:.2e} -> DOWN wins")
        down_wins += 1

# ── 9. Final determination ──────────────────────────────────────

print(f"\n{'='*80}")
print(f"SCORE: Up={up_wins}, Down={down_wins}")
print(f"{'='*80}")

# Also consider the biological interpretation:
# The question is about which direction drives metabolic effects
# Key factors:
# 1. Number of significantly enriched metabolic terms
# 2. Enrichment strength of metabolic terms
# 3. Proportion of metabolic genes in each set

# Final decision

    conclusion = "upregulation"
elif down_wins > up_wins:
